newsitem.title: CANADA: Poco Petroleums projects big gains in '97.
newsitem.headline: Poco Petroleums projects big gains in '97.

text.p: Poco Petroleums Ltd, which reported major financial and production gains for 1996, said on Thursday it expected to continue the trend this year.
Poco said its forecast for 1997 average production was 42,500 barrels per day of oil and gas liquids and 470 million cubic feet per day of natural gas.
The firm, which last year acquired junior oil company Gardiner Oil and Gas, produced an average of 34,194 barrels per day of oil and liquids and 284 million cubic feet per day of gas.
The company said the projected output was expected to result in full-year cash flow of C$360 million in 1997, up from C$231 million in 1996.
Poco said its reserve increases in 1996 replaced production by 555 percent and resulted in total proven plus probable reserves of 140 million barrels of oil and 1.4 trillion cubic feet of gas.
Cash flow increased in 1996 by 71 percent and earnings, which totalled C$34.4 million or C$0.30 per share, grew 699 percent from the year before.
